'''Abe no Yasunaga''' (安倍 泰長) was a [[Late Heian period]] {{ill|Nobility|ab|Аамсҭара|af|Adel|als|Adel|ar|نبل|ast|Nobleza|az|Zadəganlıq|ba|Дворянлыҡ|be|Знаць|be_x_old|Дваранства|bg|Аристокрация|bjn|Kasuma|br|Noblañs|bs|Plemstvo|ca|Noblesa|ckb|نەجیبزادەیی|cs|Šlechta|cv|Тăрăн|da|Adel|de|Adel|el|Ευγενείς|eo|Nobelaro|es|Nobleza|et|Aadel|eu|Noblezia|fa|نجیب‌زادگی|fi|Aateli|fr|Noblesse|frr|Aadel|fy|Eallju|ga|Uaisleacht|gan|貴族|gl|Nobreza|he|אצולה|hi|कुलीनवर्ग|hr|Plemstvo|hu|Nemesség|hy|Ազնվականություն|ia|Nobilitate|id|Bangsawan|ig|Onye isi|inh|Эздий|io|Nobeleso|is|Aðall|it|Nobiltà|ja|貴族|jv|Ningrat|ka|თავადაზნაურობა|ko|귀족|ku|Torinî|la|Nobilitas|lb|Adel|lmo|Nobiltà|lt|Diduomenė|lv|Dižciltīgie|min|Bangsawan|mk|Благородништво|mr|सामंतशाही|ms|Golongan bangsawan|myv|Мастачей|mzn|نوبرس|nds_nl|Adel|ne|भारदार परिवार|nl|Adel|nn|Adel|no|Adel|oc|Noblesa|pa|ਕੁਲੀਨਵਰਗ|pl|Szlachta|ps|اشرافیت / اشرافي خلک|pt|Nobreza|ro|Nobilime|ru|Дворянство|sh|Plemstvo|simple|Nobility|sk|Šľachta|sl|Plemstvo|sq|Fisnikëria|sr|Племство|sv|Adel|th|ชนชั้นขุนนาง|tl|Hadlika|tr|Asil|tt|Дворяннар|uk|Шляхта|uz|Dvoryanlar|vec|Nobiltà|vi|Giới quý tộc|wuu|贵族|za|Gveicuz|zh|貴族|zh_min_nan|Kùi-cho̍k|zh_yue|貴族|qid=Q134737|lt=noble}} and {{ill|Onmyōji|en|Onmyōji|qid=Q2274163|lt=onmyōji}}. He was the son of the {{ill|Onmyō Hakase|ja|陰陽博士}}, [[Abe no Ariyuki]]. His {{ill|East Asian government service ranking|ja|官位|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11452076}} was [[Junior Fourth Rank|Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade]] and he served as the [[Yin-Yang Bureau|Head of the Bureau of Divination (Onmyōryō)]].
== Career ==
Abe no Yasunaga began his court career in {{ill|Kanji|en|Kanji|qid=Q82772|lt=Kanji}} 6 (1092) when he was granted his first Rank{{ref|『師通記』寛治6th year 正月4日条}}. The following year, he attempted to concurrently serve as {{ill|Tenmon Hakase|ja|天文博士}}, though this effort was unsuccessful{{ref|『長右記』寛治7th year 2月5日条}}.
Yasunaga was promoted to {{ill|Senior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位上|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade}} in {{ill|Jōtoku|en|Jōtoku|qid=Q1193901|lt=Jōtoku}} 3 (1099){{ref|『本朝世紀』承徳3rd year 正月6日条}}, and to {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|正五位下|lt=Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}} in {{ill|Tennin|en|Tennin|qid=Q7700291|lt=Tennin}} 1 (1108){{ref|『中右記』天仁元年11月20日条}}. During this period, he held positions such as {{ill|Onmyō Hakase|ja|陰陽博士}}, {{ill|Reki Hakase|ja|暦博士}}, and {{ill|Gagaku-ryō|ja|雅楽頭|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Head of the Bureau of Court Music (Gagaku)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Head of the Bureau of Court Music (Gagaku)|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=雅楽寮|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=雅楽寮|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q8963315}}.
In {{ill|Ten'ei|en|Ten'ei|qid=Q1193915|lt=Ten'ei}} 2 (1111), he was elevated to {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位下|lt=Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade}}{{ref|『長秋記』天永2nd year 2月14日条}}, and by {{ill|Eikyū|en|Eikyū|qid=Q543201|lt=Eikyū}} 2 (1114), he was serving as the Head of the Bureau of Divination. He passed away in {{ill|Hōan|en|Hōan|qid=Q1194464|lt=Hōan}} 2 (1121) at the age of 54{{ref|赤澤、2011th year }}.
